title: Unit 3 Consolidation
goal: Review markers of probability, expressions of likelihood, the future and the conditional for guesses and adverbs of probability, and read a text about Gabriel García Márquez.

items: Review the markers of probability and the mood after them.
Review the future and the conditional for guesses, and the adverbs of probability.
Read a text about the writer Gabriel García Márquez and his novel.
I can say how sure I am about something in the present and in the past.
I can choose the right mood after a lo mejor, quizás, puede que and es probable que.
I can guess with the future, the future perfect and the conditional.
I can read a short text about García Márquez and his novel.
